user_query: I'm a travel enthusiast and I want to explore different countries. Fetch a list of webcams for Greece, Spain, and Portugal using the webcams.travel API. Additionally, provide me with the Spanish-labeled raster map tiles to enhance my travel experience.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of webcams for Greece using the webcams.travel API.
Fetch a list of webcams for Spain using the webcams.travel API.
Fetch a list of webcams for Portugal using the webcams.travel API.
Fetch Spanish-labeled raster map tiles to enhance the travel experience.
Compile the results of the webcams from Greece, Spain, and Portugal and the Spanish-labeled map tiles into a single travel plan.
